name: Highlander Reunion
overview: It has been ten years since we left Methos, Amanda, and Joe and some things have changed, while others remain the same. Love has blossomed, Immortality is still a double edged sword, and lingering feelings rise to the surface...now a very important event has brought the three old friends together in this unforgettable Highlander Reunion, but will The Game threaten to tear them apart?
